items.title: Manuel Joseph "Moose" Zanco Interview, 1959-11-25
items.q: So between the two of us, we'd worked up a duet.

ctx.x: Well, who plays down there, the banjo playing piano players?

Well, they had this captain by the name of Martin Finity. He used to be a banjo player years ago. And when I decided to bring my horn around the firehouse one day, he said he would bring his banjo. So between the two of us, we'd worked up a duet. So in the meantime, this other fella, he's a lieutenant by the name of Del Paget, Sidney Del Paget. He's the drummer. He can't buy what he said. Incidentally, Del Paget used to play with this Evolution Trio that was the craze of New Orleans many years ago. He played with…
I don't think I met him. He wasn't there the night I was down there.
